description: Land Title Settlement Department -   Asgiriya, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510426 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Nos. 21, 22, and 88) with detailed schedules showing ownership details, property descriptions, and land rights. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified for Type 4 classification.
